episode_summary: In this episode, Justin Black shares how he's using AI and SEO to generate high-value real estate leads, including nearly $5 million in transactions. He discusses building a content-rich website that answers specific client questions and using FedEx packages to convert expired listings. Justin's approach demonstrates the power of AI in modern real estate marketing.
